description: Dept. of Local Government - Eastern Province - Notice on summon of Meeting
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the summoning of meetings to fill vacancies in local authorities (Pradeshiya Sabhas) resulting from resignations of chairpersons. The notice is issued under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act and deals with electoral processes at the local government level, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7). While it mentions a government official (the Commissioner), the primary focus is on electoral procedures rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
